nodes.label: ERD Engineering Invariants & Data Philosophy
nodes.rationale: FKs enforce integrity (CASCADE for child chunks/recap, RESTRICT for active chapter links); partial GIN indexes on published books save about 80% RAM; per-book HNSW scope keeps vector latency under 10 ms; paired reversible migrations; entities map to shared DTOs; strict MVP schema with no monetization or audio tables.

nodes.label: Postgres for Everything

nodes.label: ADR-15 Authentication baseline
